metadata.description: Deploy unit for tau-storage, the private git storage app (north star DC1). Its code is the api project's storage worker, built from apps/api/Dockerfile's `storage` target; this project holds only its Fly config so ci.yml's staging plan deploys it, before the API, whenever api or this config changes.

options.command: echo 'tau-storage has no production config yet: DC1 deploys staging only (apps/storage/fly.staging.toml).' >&2 && exit 1
